description: Calculates what a machine really costs per hour to own and operate: depreciation, cost of capital, insurance/taxes/storage, fuel, lubricants, repairs and wear parts. Same math as the Torgix calculator at torgix.ai/learn. Purchase price and hours per year are required; anything else left out uses the calculator's defaults, which the answer lists.

fuel_gallons_per_hour.description: Fuel burn in gallons per hour (default 4.5)

hours_per_year.description: Hours the machine runs per year

insurance_tax_storage_pct.description: Insurance, taxes and storage as percent of average value per year (default 3)

interest_rate_pct.description: Cost of capital, percent per year (default 8)

lube_pct_of_fuel.description: Lubricants and filters as percent of fuel cost (default 15)

operator_wage_per_hour.description: Operator wage per hour; leave out for a machine-only rate

residual_value.description: Expected resale value at the end of ownership (default 30% of price)

wear_parts_cost.description: Cost of a set of tires, tracks or undercarriage (default 18,000)

wear_parts_life_hours.description: Hours a set of tires or tracks lasts (default 4,000)

years_owned.description: Years you expect to own it (default 7)

name: equipment_cost_per_hour
title: Equipment cost per hour
